name: Fathom
one_liner: AI meeting recorder (fathom.video / fathom.ai) with a REST API and webhooks for meetings, transcripts, summaries, teams.
auth_notes: OpenAPI declares X-Api-Key header and Bearer security schemes. OAuth is for public apps; OAuth apps are subject to Fathom review.
access_notes: Per-user API key from User Settings, available on all plans per FAQ (first pass). OAuth apps for public marketplace require registration and review.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve per-user API key, OpenAPI 3.1 spec with 11 paths including webhooks, cursor pagination, official MCP. OAuth for public apps requires review but API key path is open.

disputes.why: Fathom OAuth page says OAuth apps are subject to review.
Only 11 endpoints with a complete OpenAPI spec.

identity.quote: Unlimited meetings captured & instant AI summaries

auth.quote: Include your API key in the `X-Api-Key` header of every request.
They are subject to review to ensure the best experience for all users.

access.quote: Configure your redirects and receive your OAuth credentials. (2 mins)

api_surface.quote: optionally receive webhooks when content from a new meeting is ready.
